title: Sir Cyril Taylor Young African Leaders Program 2027 (AFS Youth Assembly)
organization: AFS Youth Assembly, with grant support from the Sir Cyril Taylor Charitable Foundation
overview: A 12-month programme for 10 young leaders aged 18-35 from Sub-Saharan Africa: an online AFS Global Competence Certificate, preparation workshops, the AFS Youth Assembly and an "Effect+ in the Community" workshop in Switzerland in August 2027, then a 6-month local impact project with seed funding and mentoring. Participants must run the workshop for at least 100 young people at home. The organiser describes it as fully funded, with travel and accommodation for the Youth Assembly covered.
program_dates: 12 months; AFS Youth Assembly and "Effect+ in the Community" workshop in Switzerland in August 2027 (exact days not stated); online certificate and workshops before; 6-month impact project after
deadline_text: "Application Deadline: November 19, 2026 23:59 UTC" (AFS Youth Assembly announcement posted 16 October 2026, read 2 November 2026). The organiser adds: "Applications will be reviewed on a first come first served basis."
funding_details: AFS Youth Assembly: "This is a 12-month fully funded scholarship that covers the costs of participating in all program elements listed below."
AFS Youth Assembly: "Travel and accommodation for the AFS Youth Assembly will be covered for the participants in this program."
Seed funding is provided for the impact project; the amount is not stated.
stipend: None stated; seed funding for the impact project (amount not stated)
experience_requirement: "Have demonstrable leadership qualities or proven track record of leadership experience"; leading a social impact project related to the SDGs is preferred, not required
nationality_requirements: "Must be from a Sub-Saharan African country" (the DRC is in Sub-Saharan Africa)
eligibility: Aged 18-35
From a Sub-Saharan African country
Demonstrable leadership qualities or a track record of leadership
Unexpired passport
Able to attend the Youth Assembly in Geneva, Switzerland, in person in August 2027
Intermediate English
Interest in global affairs, sustainable development and youth issues
Leading a social impact project related to the SDGs (preferred)
other_requirements: After returning home, run the "Effect+ in the Community" workshop for at least 100 young people
Work on an impact project for 6 months with mentoring
application_process: Apply through the "Apply Now" form linked from the AFS Youth Assembly announcement before 19 November 2026, 23:59 UTC
The organiser encourages early applications because visa processing can take several months, and discourages using AI to write the narrative

title: Telemachus & Athena Mentoring Programmes 2027 (Global Thinkers Forum)
organization: Global Thinkers Forum (GTF), a London-based non-profit
overview: An eight-month online mentoring programme starting in January 2027 that pairs each mentee with a volunteer mentor from fields such as public policy, business, entrepreneurship, media, academia, non-profit and science. Telemachus is for young people aged 18-29 from anywhere in the world; Athena is for women aged over 22 with no upper age limit. Mentor and mentee meet virtually at least once a month; mentees receive a completion certificate and can take an optional 3-month internship with GTF.
deadline_text: "Applications deadline: November 23, 2026" (GTF mentees application page, read 2 November 2026); no time or time zone given.
funding_details: The GTF pages read on 2 November 2026 mention no fee and no payment to mentees; mentors are described as "volunteering their time".
GTF FAQ: "You will also earn an optional 3-month internship with GTF" (pay for that internship not stated).
age_requirement: Telemachus: "a young individual between 18-29"; Athena: "women above the age of 22 and without age limit"
experience_requirement: No minimum stated. GTF: "Applicants with fluent command of English, who have completed a Bachelor's degree or have equally-relevant professional experience of a minimum of 5 years will be prioritised."
education_requirement: None required; holders of a bachelor's degree (or 5 years of relevant experience) are prioritised
language_requirement: Fluent English is prioritised (mentoring is in English; Arabic may be possible only for Athena MENA)
eligibility: Telemachus: aged 18-29, from any country
Athena: women aged over 22, no upper age limit
Priority to fluent English speakers with a bachelor's degree or at least 5 years of relevant experience
Mentees who already took part in a cycle cannot take part again
other_requirements: At least one virtual meeting with the mentor each month for eight months
documents_required: Motivation letter explaining what you want to achieve and why you want to be mentored
application_process: Complete the form on the GTF mentees application page before 23 November 2026, or email the motivation letter as described on the GTF guidelines

title: CMU-Africa Certificate in Artificial Intelligence for Africa (cohort starting January 2027)
overview: Reported by secondary sources: a six-course online certificate in applied artificial intelligence for the African context, with 14-15 lessons per course, digital badges per course and a verifiable certificate (not university credit). Secondary sources say it is "cost-free for qualified applicants", needs basic linear algebra, probability and statistics and programming, and at least 5-6 hours a week. Applications reported open 15 October to 15 November 2026; cohort reported to start 17 January 2027; enrolment by invitation. The official CMU-Africa page could not be read on 2 November 2026.

title: Officially Green Global Fellowship, February 2027 cohort
overview: A sustainability fellowship for people aged 18-35 from around the world, starting with a February 2027 cohort. Fellows take a compulsory online course (MOOC), attend the fellowship conferences, set up an "Officially Green Club" of at least 20 pupils in a primary or secondary school, promote seven sustainability pledges online and report on their impact. A certificate is given only on completion; one fellow may receive a US$1,000 post-fellowship award. No prior sustainability experience is required.
program_dates: February 2027 cohort; end date not stated
deadline_text: "Application Deadline: January 7, 2027 Closing Time: 4:00 p.m. GMT" (Green Institute fellowship page, read 2 November 2026; the same page also shows "at 4:00 GMT" in another place). Outcomes announced by email "during the first week of February 2027".
funding_details: No fee and no payment to fellows are mentioned on the fellowship page or the first page of the application form read on 2 November 2026.

Green Institute: "US$1,000 Grand Prize (One fellow who fulfils all fellowship requirements and demonstrates documented impact may receive a US$1,000 post-fellowship award ... selection alone does not guarantee funding.)"
age_requirement: "Be between 18 and 35 years old at the application deadline."
experience_requirement: FAQ: "No. You do not need to be a sustainability expert or have extensive prior experience." Application form: "No prior professional experience in sustainability is required."
language_requirement: Unknown / Not specified (page and form are in English)
eligibility: Aged 18-35 at the application deadline
Genuine commitment to sustainability and environmental action
Committed to running an Officially Green Club in a school
Available to attend all designated conferences and take part actively
Reliable internet access; able to document activities and impact
other_requirements: Set up and sustain an Officially Green Club with at least 20 young students in a primary or secondary school
Promote the seven Officially Green pledges on social media with #OfficiallyGreen
Submit brief reports on activities and impact
documents_required: Application form asks for contact details, country of residence, current status, affiliation and a LinkedIn page (first page of four read)
application_process: Apply through the Google Form linked from the Green Institute fellowship page before 7 January 2027
